title: TheUndergrowth
description: To enhance the over-world without adding biomes, but instead reworking the already existing ones
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f62e728ccb8645bdbee73c4f4ab4054eb58db7f.png)

Undergrowth is a small quality of life mod intended to add small changes to biomes, and rework how they generate from the ground up.

It is generally a very pretty big change to the generation while adding a few trees. I will also state sometimes the trees do not generate properly.

Generally I recommend using compatibility datapacks, which will be posted below as I devolp them.

This mod it's self will be going under a rewrite as of post 1.5 due to the state of it being in mcreator
